title: Uganda Climate Intelligence Framework (UCIF)

creators.name: Masaba, Jeremiah
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computing and Communication Sciences, Makerere University, Kampala, Uganda

description: Reproducible research package (code, curated disaster register, results and manuscript) behind A Climate Intelligence Framework for Detecting, Validating and Assessing Weather Anomalies in Uganda. The pipeline benchmarks unsupervised anomaly detectors against an external disaster ground-truth, extends the record to a 91-year in-situ series, adds an independent NASA POWER gap-fill of the 1990-2007 observing collapse, derives SPI/SPEI drought indices, links them to a 64-year cereal-yield series, and computes the UCASI severity index with SHAP explainability. Every reported number is generated by python run_all.py; no values are fabricated.
notes: Code is released under the MIT licence. Third-party data sources (ERA5 via Open-Meteo, Meteostat, NASA POWER, World Bank/FAOSTAT) and the curated disaster register remain under their own licences; see README.md 'Data and licensing'. Large raw/derived data files are gitignored and regenerated by the pipeline. Manuscript under review.
software_requirements: numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn, pyod, statsmodels, pymannkendall, ruptures, shap, scikit-posthocs, matplotlib, seaborn, geopandas, meteostat
